dc_eval_cbrn.quote: In summary, the model did not meet our most conservative biological risk thresholds, and our expert consultants agreed.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: bio threshold determination plus human uplift trial result

dc_eval_cyber.quote: We judged that the model did not pass the ASL-3 threshold on any of the early indicator tests. The model did score 30% on one of the vulnerability discovery tasks

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Across all the rounds, the model was clearly below our ARA ASL-3 risk threshold, having failed at least 3 out of 5 tasks

dc_eval_persuasion.note: no persuasion/manipulation evaluation; election-misinformation testing (7.2) is misuse refusal, not persuasion capability

dc_eval_scheming.note: 'deceiving humans' appears only as a component of ARA tasks (coded autonomy); needle-in-haystack test-awareness remark is framed as a benchmark limitation, not misalignment risk

framework_threshold.quote: Our results show no indicators of catastrophic risk, and therefore we classify all of our Claude 3 models as ASL-2.

ext_test_any.quote: We conduct vulnerability testing using internal and external human testers to explore over a dozen policy categories – these results have been integrated into our safety mitigations.
ext_test_any.locator: 7 Trust & Safety and Societal Impact Evaluations
ext_test_any.note: external human testers in the Claude 3 trust & safety testing; no statement it was after release

ext_test_named_org.note: no outside organisation named; 'expert consultants/advisors' unnamed

ext_test_government.note: only references to White House commitments / Executive Order guidance, no government testing

ext_test_timing_stated.note: 'before deployment' sentence refers to Anthropic's own testing in general; no explicit statement that the external testing happened before release

safeguards_training.quote: Using this Constitution, models are trained to avoid sexist, racist, and toxic outputs, as well as to avoid helping a human engage in illegal or unethical activities.

safeguards_runtime.quote: we run classifiers on user prompts that are trained to identify violations of our AUP as they occur
safeguards_runtime.note: runtime classifiers; also CBRN/cyber prompt detection

safeguards_access.quote: To manage potential risks, we incrementally roll out access to our products to ensure their safety and reliability
safeguards_access.note: incremental access rollout stated for safety

safeguards_weights.quote: We harden security against opportunistic attackers for all copies of Claude 3 model weights.
